name: Eastern Edge Robotics
title: Chief Operating Officer (2023-2026) • Software Lead (2022-2023)
text: An undergraduate team that designs and operates a Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) for the international MATE ROV Competition.
bullets: Led a 35-member cross-functional team (software, electrical, mechanical) to a team 1st-place finish at the 2026 MATE EXPLORER World Championship, owning prioritization and trade-off decisions under a fixed budget and deadline
Part of the team that placed 1st in Engineering Presentation at the 2022 and 2023 MATE ROV World Championship
Decided each season which capabilities to build, defer, or cut by weighing technical effort, risk, and competition value
Served as the link between technical builders and non-technical stakeholders, including sponsors, judges, and university administration
Architected the ROV control system in Python and ROS2, including a diagnostics GUI and integrated thrusters, servos, lighting, and network communications

name: Paradigm Engineering
title: Path Planning Lead
text: An undergraduate team developing an autonomous self-driving vehicle for the International eV Grand Prix Competition.
bullets: Developed a path-planning algorithm for a high-speed vehicle navigating a dynamic environment
Designed a vehicle and pit crew communication system for real-time updates using Python and UDP
Tested the algorithm and system in a ROS2 simulation environment

name: Engineering Student Society
title: Director of Communications
text: A student-run organization that represents engineering students at Memorial University and organizes events and initiatives to enhance the student experience.
bullets: Led communications for the society as a director on its student executive
Contributed to the society's website, a hub for engineering at Memorial
Attended two conferences: CELC 2023 and CSE 2024
